purpose: Allow the three source-incomplete Level 5 registered variants to use their exact official PDF instruction pages, with clear incompleteness disclosure. This is owner authorization for inclusion, NOT artwork verification.

items.limitation: Detached wheel on the final optimized instruction page
items.questionPolicy: Owner-authorized general construction self-assessment; not independent certification of source-specific features or model completion

questions.text: Did you build Crack Shot using the Optimized manual rather than the separate Basic version?
Have you completed every attachment shown in the Optimized manual, including its final wheel-assembly instructions?
Are all parts shown separately in the final instruction stage now attached as directed?
Are the assembled frame, wheel supports and connectors securely fitted, according to the Optimized manual?
Have you checked your assembled Optimized model against each official construction step and corrected anything missing?

items.limitation: The final manual page shows a rubber-band/connector attachment step, not a fully assembled model
items.questionPolicy: Owner-authorized general construction self-assessment; not independent certification of source-specific features or model completion

questions.text: Have you followed all assembly steps in the official Machine Gun Building manual?
Have you completed the final rubber-band and connector attachment described on page 29?
Are the parts shown separately during the last attachment step now installed as directed?
Are the model's mechanical and structural connections securely fitted according to the manual?
Have you checked the finished construction against the official instructions and corrected missing or loose parts?

items.limitation: The final instruction page shows a camera module detached beside the clock
items.questionPolicy: Owner-authorized general construction self-assessment; not independent certification of source-specific features or model completion

questions.text: Have you followed every step of the official Facial Recognition Time Clock Building manual?
Have you completed the camera-module attachment instructed on page 7?
Is the camera module securely mounted rather than still detached as in the instruction illustration?
Have you checked the camera orientation, supports and connectors against the official instructions?
Have you compared the assembled clock with all manual construction steps and corrected missing or loose parts?
